[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Nahpui Quarter | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=265 }} [[Nahpui Quarter]] is a slum area of [[Kaineng City]], bordering the bustling [[Wajjun Bazaar]] and the quaint peacefulness around [[Senji's Corner]]. The [[Am Fah]] and the [[Jade Brotherhood]] make regular incursions into this area in an attempt to wrest control. == Getting there == Exit from [[Senji's Corner]] or travel through [[Shenzun Tunnels]]. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: * [[Champion of Balthazar]] ** North, at the exit into [[Senji's Corner]]. * [[Melandru's Watcher]] ** Southeast, at the exit into [[Shenzun Tunnels]]. == NPCs == === Charmable animals === * {{x}} 15 (15) [[Crane|Elder Crane]] (one; pet of [[Royen Beastkeeper]]) === Foes === [[Human]]s ([[Am Fah]]) * {{r}} 20 (26) [[Am Fah Marksman]] * {{mo}} 20 (26) [[Am Fah Healer]] * {{n}} 20 (26) [[Am Fah Necromancer]] * {{a}} 20 (26) [[Am Fah Assassin]] Humans ([[Jade Brotherhood]]) * {{w}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Knight]] * {{me}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mesmer]] * {{e}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mage]] * {{rt}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ritualist]] ==== Bosses ==== Humans (Jade Brotherhood) * {{r}} 24 (30) [[Royen Beastkeeper]] → [[Enraged Lunge]] ([[Royen's Hornbow]]) == Notes == *{{Vanquisher|count = 110|low = 96|high = 112|notes=Has hidden groups of [[Jade Brotherhood]].}} ** The western section of the area (the [[Nahpui Quarter|Nahpui Quarter mission]] area) does not contain any [[creature]]s, friendly or hostile. ** During [[Architect of Corruption (Hard mode)|Architect of Corruption]], the number of foes rises to about 394. The western section of the area (the [[Nahpui Quarter|Nahpui Quarter mission]] area) will contain Am Fah. {{Explorable areas in Kaineng City}} [[de:Nahpuiviertel (Erforschbar)]]
